name: bouldering
description: Climbing short problems close to the ground above crash pads, without a rope. It trains finger strength, power and movement skill, from hard limit attempts to high-volume sessions.
instructions: Warm up on easy problems and build up the difficulty gradually.
Choose problems that fit the session goal, such as hard attempts, volume or a technique theme.
Place your feet precisely and keep your arms as straight as you can.
Climb down or drop onto the pads, landing on your feet with bent knees.
Rest long enough between hard attempts to try each one fresh.
Stop before tiredness makes your movement sloppy.
